The structure of Nb6Mg18Bi2 (reduced formula Nb3Mg9Bi) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 26 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: Bi and Nb centers have eight Mg neighbors, while Mg centers have four Nb and four Bi neighbors, with neighbor distances near 2.88–3.06 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include Mg–Mg 8-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Nb–Nb polyhedra sharing corners and faces.
